main_body: A wooden counter base (rows 22-31) topped by a glass dome that covers a tiered cake (rows 10-22). The dome is drawn face-on.
top_band: No real top band. At the centre column the dome is pale blue glass from row 10 to 21, then a light orange wood line at rows 22-23. That line is only about 2 rows and reads as a rim.
evidence: The counter top is a 1-2 row light orange rim, too thin to read as a surface. Below it is a flat front face with inset panels. The dome and cake are a flat face-on silhouette, and no horizontal surface (the cake stand top, or the counter top seen from above) is visible. The object reads as a front elevation with a thin cap line.

style.evidence: The glass dome is a large, almost flat pale-blue fill with only a thin highlight rim. The cake has about 3 flat tiers. The wooden base has some ramp steps (orange, brown, dark brown) and a dark brown outline, but almost no grain or texture dots. Tiles carry fewer colours than the stall and well references, and the piece looks thinner and flatter next to them.
